title: plugin-security: os explain's FLS layer reports a row-conditioned field lock as applying "everywhere else" to a caller holding Modify All, whose vote overrides that lock since #29387
body:
domain:spec#5 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbWR3K3h7i1ytwycVg1

Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with a named location. It is a follow-up owed by landed work (PR #29387, #29106, ruling 6573563853 A), filed under 「已落地工作欠的后续照立卡」.

## Defect

`packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/explain-engine.ts` builds `conditionedSentence` (≈L2966). For every field entry that carries a `when`, it says the entry is "judged per row by the write gate, applied as the lock everywhere else". Since PR #29387, `getFieldPermissions` applies the View All / Modify All vote after the per-entry vote, under all three `when` verdicts (matched, unmatched, unjudged). That holds in the write gate, in the row-blind readers and in the record-scoped projection. So for a caller holding Modify All on the object, a row-conditioned lock never binds. The explain sentence still lists it as a lock.

- Direction: restrictive. The report claims more restriction than is enforced and grants nothing. The layer's hidden/partial mask is correct; only this sentence is wrong.
- `reach:` read from code, not yet measured. This was found by the at-tier contract review of PR #29599 (record 6588636490) and confirmed in ACCEPT 6588662613 item 5. The first acceptance step is to measure it once through the public entry: `os explain` (or the explain HTTP route) for a caller whose set grants Modify All on an object that has a `when`-conditioned field entry. If the sentence does not list the entry, close as not reproduced.

## Business reason

Admins, and AI authors debugging field access, use `os explain` to learn why a field behaves the way it does. For a Modify All holder the report tells them a field is locked on rows the condition does not match, but the field is editable. That leads them to add grants they do not need or to misdiagnose a write that succeeds. Without a fix, the report and the enforcement disagree for every Modify All holder on every object with a conditioned entry.

## Reader

domain:server seat, plugin-security. In `conditionedSentence`, drop or annotate entries whose object the caller holds Modify All on (and treat a read-only lock the same way for View All). Add one test in `explain-engine.test.ts` next to the `[#25866]` row-condition test, using a Modify All set.

Suggested priority: p3. This is report prose with no enforcement change.

## Duplicate check

Searched `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue` for `"applied as the lock"` (2 hits: #29543 open, which is this finding's source card and is docs-only; #25866 closed, which introduced the sentence), `conditionedSentence` (1 hit: #29543), and `explain conditioned lock "Modify All"` (4 hits: #29543 plus three seat posts). None tracks this defect.
